headword: {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}
gloss: official name; formal name; full official designation

definitions.gloss: official name; formal name; full official designation
definitions.explanation: The full, official name of an organization, law, product, or other entity, as opposed to a common abbreviation or nickname. Often used when introducing a new item or when clarifying what a commonly used short name actually stands for.

examples.japanese: {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
「⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「コンビニエンスストア」だ。
examples.english: The official name of "konbini" is "convenience store."

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be sure to enter the official name of the company on the documents.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧ (formal, official) and ⟦{名称|めいしょう}→名称：12031_meishou⟧ (name, designation). Used especially when contrasting a formal name with a nickname, abbreviation, or everyday term — a very common rhetorical move in Japanese quiz shows, trivia, and news explanations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜: the official name is...
- {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call (something) by its official name
- {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to write in the official name
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}: the official name of the company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{略称|りゃくしょう}→略称：13562_ryakushou⟧: abbreviated name, short name — the opposite of {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}
- ⟦{通称|つうしょう}→通称：14404_tsuushou⟧: common name, popular name — what something is usually called in practice
- ⟦{名称|めいしょう}→名称：12031_meishou⟧: name, designation (the general word, without the "official" nuance)
- ⟦{本名|ほんみょう}→本名：13034_honmyou⟧: real name — used for people, not organizations
